lpml.title: Scala

rightbox.p: Developer: École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne: Programming Methods Laboratory

lpml.p: Scala is a statically-typed, high-level, general-purpose programming language designed to be concise and fix Java's problems.
Scala code can run on a JVM, transpiled to JavaScript to run on the Web, or compiled directly using Clang.

The design of Scala started in 2001 at a public research university, École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne, in Lausanne, Switzerland by Martin Odersky. After an internal release in 2003, Scala was released publicly in early 2004. A second version was released in March 2006.
